author: Synthesized with Maya1 by Maya Research
changes: Each rogue's lines spoken by tools/voices/build_voices_maya.py in a voice designed for it from a written description (tools/voices/maya_voices.json), held steady by two anchor sentences in that voice (tools/voices/anchors/), the best of several takes kept (checked with Whisper and Chatterbox's voice encoder), trimmed, levelled and packed into one Ogg Vorbis file per rogue
used_for: Rogues speaking their taunts out loud
